overview: Deterministic E2E validation that run start honors readiness gating and report triage tabs preserve run-scoped filtering.
goals: Keep run progress visible and accurate.
successMetrics: Blocked-run path returns explicit conflict state.
Triage filters match row status sets without scope loss.
uiNotes: Quick Start blocked reason must be explicit.
Triage tabs (`All`, `Needs Review`, `Reviewed`, `Flagged`) must produce deterministic subsets.

importFormat.description: Scenario uses seeded matter states for blocked and runnable preconditions.

rules: Triage filtering must preserve selected run scope.

stories.title: Start Run When Ready, Then Triage by Status
stories.description: As an operator, I need run start gating and triage filtering to stay deterministic so review work is trustworthy.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a blocked matter, Quick Start shows blocked reason and does not create a run.
When matter becomes runnable and Quick Start is triggered, run state and progress become visible.
Then triage tabs filter report rows by status while preserving the active run scope.
Example: `Needs Review` tab shows only `needs_review` rows and count equals visible set.
Negative: blocked start attempt returns explicit conflict error and no hidden run creation.
